steps.description: Identify root causes and framing questions
Present them side-by-side in a short report

payload.title: Loyalty happy-hour after 2pm
payload.description: Punch-card that only fills on weekday afternoons, so regulars learn the slow hours are the cheap hours and start drifting in then.

payload.title: Laptop-corner day pass
payload.description: Sell a $6 afternoon pass for a quiet corner with outlets and fast wifi; the coffee's extra, the seat is the product.

payload.title: Pastry rescue box
payload.description: Bag up the morning's unsold pastries at 3pm for half price; turns waste into a reason to walk in after lunch.

payload.title: Second-cup half-price token
payload.description: Anyone who bought a morning coffee gets a token for a half-price afternoon refill, redeemable same day only.

payload.title: Neighborhood remote-work club
payload.description: A monthly membership that reserves afternoon seating and a bottomless drip, aimed at the work-from-home crowd nearby.

payload.title: Kids draw, parents stay
payload.description: Free crayons and a wall to pin drawings on; parents on the school run linger and order a second drink.

payload.title: Afternoon tasting flight
payload.description: Three 4oz pours of single-origin for the price of a latte, framed as a slow-hour ritual, not a rush purchase.

payload.title: Bring-a-friend 3-to-5
payload.description: Between 3 and 5, two drinks ring up as one-and-a-half; the empty room fills because nobody comes alone.

payload.title: Standing pre-order for offices
payload.description: Nearby offices set a recurring 3pm tray order; you batch-make it, they expense it, the lull disappears.

payload.title: Silent-hour study deal
payload.description: Declare 2-4pm phone-free and discount drip 30%; the vibe itself becomes the draw for students.

payload.title: Cold-brew growler refills
payload.description: Sell branded growlers, refill cold brew cheap in the afternoon; regulars stock their fridge and your slow hours move volume.

payload.title: Barista's-choice mystery cup
payload.description: A $3 afternoon-only mystery drink the barista improvises; cheap experiment that turns dead time into a game.

payload.title: Afterschool hot-chocolate route
payload.description: Partner with the school two blocks over for a hot-chocolate punch card kids redeem walking home.

payload.title: Co-working stamp partnership
payload.description: Tie up with a co-working space: their members flash a badge for afternoon discounts, you get their overflow.

payload.title: Slow-hour catering sampler
payload.description: Use the lull to bake mini catering samplers and hand them to office managers who walk past at 3.

payload.title: Pay-what-it-weighs cookies
payload.description: Afternoon cookies priced by the gram on a little scale at the counter; novelty pulls the curious in.

payload.title: Reverse rush-hour playlist
payload.description: A posted live DJ-style afternoon playlist; people come for the set, the coffee is incidental.

payload.title: Two-for-Tuesday iced drinks
payload.description: Every Tuesday afternoon, iced drinks are buy-one-gift-one; the gifted one drags in a new face.

payload.title: Window-seat reservation app
payload.description: Let people reserve the good window seat for an afternoon hour for a small fee that's redeemable on food.

payload.title: Local-maker pop-up shelf
payload.description: Rent a shelf to a local maker who hosts an afternoon demo; their followers become your 3pm traffic.

payload.title: Loyalty happy-hour after 2pm — variant
payload.description: Push it wilder — what if it ran all week, not just afternoons?

payload.title: Laptop-corner day pass — variant
payload.description: Ground it — tie the trigger to the existing POS punch-card so staff do nothing new.

payload.title: Pastry rescue box — variant
payload.description: Pressure-test — who hates this, and what breaks at 50 covers?

payload.title: Second-cup half-price token — variant
payload.description: Cross it with the loyalty app so the token lives on a phone, not paper.

payload.title: Neighborhood remote-work club — variant
payload.description: Invert it — instead of discounting, make the slow hour feel exclusive and charge more.
